shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/power/pipes, linked weather, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH and VEF PipeSystem support as SOFT compat (ModsConfig-gated, compile-only references, JIT-safe isolation).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync, weather, power, pipes); fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (T0-T3 signed off; T4 in progress)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; loss-proof StairTransfer; PageUp/PageDown level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, lit face rows, fogged core, guaranteed mining reveal.
- See-below renderer: whitelisted content layers only (no overlay of any origin can cross levels); air-cells light mask; live dynamic things below; far clip 70.
- Weather link every 150 ticks. Live sync via MapEvents (rooftop coupling, floor-to-roof, fall-through).
- Cross-level work, idle return, drafted gizmos, colony-wide tables; hauling (storage + construction demand + right-click orders); needs (bed redirect); one-colony resource counts.
- Power across levels (T4b.2, shared-tank model): each stairwell side is a small lossless battery (200 Wd, transmits power, visible charge bar). Vanilla nets charge it with surplus and feed consumers from it; the pair equalizes every 30 ticks (master side computes). The RECEIVING side forwards its charge into the local net's ordinary batteries at their own charge efficiency (vanilla has no battery-to-battery transfer, so upstairs banks would otherwise never fill); a direction flag keeps the producing side from churning energy in circles. Fake-producer model rejected and documented in lore (PowerOn gating + deficit-hiding). VERIFIED PENDING: bank charging upstairs.
- Pipe networks (T4b, VERIFIED in compat run): DBH plumbing water and VEF PipeSystem resources equalize through stairwells touching pipes on both levels; damped, public APIs only; DBH sewage needs per-level handling.

## Quadruple pass log
T4b.2: flow chain audited end to end (surplus -> source bridge -> equalize -> receiving bridge -> bank at charge efficiency; conservation exact minus vanilla charging loss); churn prevention by direction flag; stale-flag cases self-correct. Confidence: power bridge 88%, DBH bridge verified live, VEF bridge 85% (load-verified, awaiting consumer mod for flow), isolation 90%.
Known gaps: DBH sewage per-level; VEF flow test needs a consumer mod; bills cross-level fetch; renderer polish backlog; bridge batteries are zzzt-eligible (kept small).

## Tranche plan
- T0-T3 DONE. T4a/T4b pipes VERIFIED; T4b.2 power retest pending.
- T4c: temperature sync, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling.
- Publishing prep per global rules.

## Status
T4b.2 compiled green, pushed. Pending retest: upstairs battery bank charges from downstairs solar through the stairwell bridge.
